scope.market_definition: The commercial aircraft market encompasses the production, distribution, and servicing of aircraft designed for passenger and cargo transport. Key participants include manufacturers, distributors, and service providers operating globally to meet the demands of airlines and freight companies.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the distribution of commercial aircraft and related components through various channels.
This layer focuses on the resale of aircraft and components to end-users.
This layer includes companies that integrate systems and provide services related to aircraft.
